svg.title: A device name does not establish route or contents
svg.desc: Original learning map separating subcutaneous tissue delivery, intravenous vein delivery, and device-specific priming volume from drug concentration and the ordered patient dose. Not an insertion or tubing-connection diagram.

g.text: Name is not proof of route
Identify the real device, label and established plan.
Not an intravenous bolus or an automatic fluid plan.
Delivery is into a vein through verified access.
Priming volume: contents of this particular set
Patient dose: the authorized amount to deliver
A clear-looking tube may contain medication.
Concept map only. Not setup, flushing or insertion steps.
